turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero and when.
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
Not yet, Hale. The principal's office is down the hall and I know the way. Who decided, and when?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
"Between us." No deal, Hale, and nothing about my son's mark stays off the record. Tell me who entered that zero and on what basis, or I'm going upstairs.
